findings.title: After a merge the skill waits with --until done, which a story merged at ready never meets
findings.repro: Supervise a quick story to `ready`, person merges the PR; the subagent loops on `--until done --timeout 5m`, exit 7 each time.
findings.detail:
SKILL.md:21 and :35 order `norn story wait <story> --until done` after the person merges the PR. view/src/wait.ts:87-88: `done` holds only when the unit's status is done ($done). A story merged at a `ready` gate stays parked there; GR6 cleanup sets story_status done and removes the worktree, so the cursor never reaches $done. The wait times out every 5m forever, or is refused once the story leaves the view. `merged` (wait.ts:89-90) holds once pr_state is merged or story_status is done.
Axis: spec
